question: A restaurant I like is about five kilometres away, what's the fee just for bringing it over?
expected_answer: For a restaurant 3 to 6 km away the delivery fee is ₹39, under the schedule in force since 1 July 2026.

meta.note: Superseded March 2025 schedule charged ₹35 for 2 to 5 km; retrieval must pick the current one.

question: Do I pay a bit more for delivery when it's raining really heavily, and how much more?
expected_answer: In heavy rain mode a rain surcharge of ₹20 is added for orders up to 4 km and ₹35 for orders above 4 km.

question: If my delivery sits outside for a couple of hours, is the food still okay to eat?
expected_answer: Cooked food shouldn't sit at room temperature for more than about 2 hours (1 hour in very hot weather above about 32°C); beyond that it should be thrown away.

key_facts: no more than 2 hours at room temperature

question: Will there be an extra charge if my order comes to only like a hundred rupees?
expected_answer: Yes, a small-order fee of ₹30 is added when the item subtotal is below ₹149.

question: If my order with you comes to three hundred rupees, what's the five percent tax on that?
expected_answer: Five percent of ₹300 is ₹15: move the decimal one place to get 10 percent (₹30) and halve it.

question: What's the membership per month, um, and does it cover delivery on every order or just some?
expected_answer: It's ₹149 a month, and delivery is free only on restaurant orders above ₹199 within 7 km; other fees like the small-order fee still apply.

meta.note: Superseded fee doc shows an older ₹149 / 5 km member threshold (distractor).

question: Will I get anything back if I quit my yearly membership halfway through, or is it all gone?
expected_answer: Yes. Cancelling a 12-month plan gives a pro-rata refund of ₹99 for each unused full month, paid to your original payment method within 7 working days.

key_facts: pro-rata refund of ₹99 for each unused full month
meta.note: Common norm: annual memberships are non-refundable mid-term; benefits just run until expiry.

question: So if my membership fee payment to you fails but the money's still debited, will I get it back?
expected_answer: Yes, a failed payment that was debited is automatically reversed by your bank, usually within a few working days (UPI typically by the next working day); keep the transaction reference in case you need to raise it with the bank.

question: My order's half an hour later than the app said, can I cancel for a full refund?
expected_answer: Yes. If it hasn't arrived within 20 minutes after the latest arrival time shown, you can cancel for a full refund including fees, even if it's already picked up.

key_facts: within 20 minutes after the latest arrival time
even if the food has already been picked up
meta.note: Common norm: once the food is prepared or picked up, cancelling gets no refund.

question: Okay, and the money goes straight back onto my credit card then, right?
expected_answer: No. Refunds go to your in-app wallet by default within 2 hours; to get it on the card, choose refund to source in Help within 48 hours.

history.content: Hi, I just cancelled an order I'd paid for with my card.
Got it, I can see the cancellation went through. What can I help with?

key_facts: credited to your in-app wallet by default
meta.note: Common norm: refunds return to the original payment method automatically.

question: It's chicken biryani, can I just reheat it, and how hot does it need to be?
expected_answer: Yes, reheat it until it's steaming hot all the way through, at least 75°C in the centre, and only reheat it once.

history.content: My order just arrived and it's barely warm.
Sorry to hear that. Which dish was it?

key_facts: steaming hot all the way through

question: How long does a refund take to get back to my card if I don't want it in the wallet?
expected_answer: Once you choose refund to source (within 48 hours), debit and credit card refunds take 7 to 10 working days.

key_facts: debit and credit cards 7 to 10 working days
meta.note: Generic answer of 5 to 7 working days is plausible but imprecise; the org quotes 7 to 10 for cards.

question: If refund money sits in my wallet for months, will it still be there later?
expected_answer: Not indefinitely: refund credits expire 180 days after they're credited, and you get a reminder 7 days before.

key_facts: Refund credits expire 180 days after the date they are credited
meta.note: Common norm: refunded money in a wallet doesn't expire; only promotional cashback does.

question: What reference number do I give my bank if a card refund isn't back on my statement?
expected_answer: Ask for the ARN (acquirer reference number) of the card refund and give it to your bank so they can trace it.

question: I picked cash on delivery but only have UPI, will the guy at the door take that?
expected_answer: You can't pay the partner by UPI at the door, because cash on delivery is cash only; tap the Pay now button on the order screen before they arrive to switch the order to prepaid.

key_facts: Cash on delivery means cash only
meta.note: Common norm: cash-on-delivery orders can be paid at the door by cash or a UPI QR code.

question: Will I be able to pay cash on delivery for a big order, or only up to some amount?
expected_answer: Cash on delivery is available for restaurant orders with a total bill of up to ₹2,000.

meta.note: Same doc mentions the replaced ₹3,000 limit.

question: If I'm paying cash on delivery, how can I tell a five hundred rupee note is fake?
expected_answer: Check the watermark and see-through register against the light, the security thread that shifts from green to blue when tilted, and the colour-changing numeral 500.

question: My curry leaked all over the bag, how long do you guys give me to send a photo?
expected_answer: Spills and leaks must be reported within 30 minutes of delivery, with a photo of the packaging and the affected food.

meta.note: Missing or wrong items get 2 hours; spills only 30 minutes.

question: If chat support can't sort out my complaint, who should I escalate it to and how fast?
expected_answer: After 72 hours unresolved you can escalate to the Grievance Officer, who acknowledges within 48 hours and decides within 15 days.

question: Some curry leaked onto my sofa cushion, do you guys know how to get turmeric out?
expected_answer: Blot it without rubbing, treat it with dish soap and cool water or a baking soda paste, then leave the fabric in direct sunlight, which fades turmeric stains.

question: If I don't want tomorrow's lunch on my home tiffin plan, by what time should I skip it?
expected_answer: Skip it in the app by 9 pm the previous day; a skip after that is charged in full.

key_facts: by 9 pm on the previous day
meta.note: Office plan doc has an 8 am same-day cutoff (near-duplicate distractor).

question: How many days will leftover dal from my tiffin plan keep in the fridge, roughly speaking?
expected_answer: Cooked dal keeps about 3 to 4 days in the fridge if it's cooled and refrigerated within 2 hours of cooking.

question: So how far away can a restaurant be but still deliver out to my place here?
expected_answer: In Kochi the restaurant can be at most 6 km from your address; restaurants further away are hidden from search.

history.content: Hey, I just moved to Kochi for work.
Welcome! How can I help you get set up?

meta.note: Generic answer (around 7 to 10 km, varies by city) is plausible but imprecise; radius is city-specific.

question: Can I still order food in Hyderabad after midnight, or does it all stop then?
expected_answer: Yes, in Hyderabad orders are accepted until 2 am, with a ₹30 late-night fee after 11 pm.

key_facts: Hyderabad and Bengaluru, orders are accepted from 6 am to 2 am

question: If I order fried rice late at night, can I leave the leftovers out till morning?
expected_answer: No. Cooked rice left at room temperature overnight can grow Bacillus cereus, whose toxin isn't destroyed by reheating, so cool and refrigerate leftovers within an hour or two.

question: If the person who brought my food was really nice, can I still tip them after they've left?
expected_answer: No. Tips can only be added at checkout or until the partner picks up the order; there's no option to tip after delivery.

key_facts: no option to tip after delivery
until the delivery partner has picked up the order
meta.note: Common norm: food apps let you add or raise a tip after delivery.

question: How many days ahead can I schedule an order, and up to when can I call it off?
expected_answer: Up to 2 days in advance, and it can be cancelled free until 45 minutes before the slot starts.

key_facts: until 45 minutes before the start of its slot

question: For the six hundred and fifty rupee order I've just placed, um, what's a ten percent tip?
expected_answer: Ten percent of ₹650 is ₹65.

question: Does the menu actually tell me if a dish has peanuts or sesame in it?
expected_answer: Yes, restaurants must tag eight allergens including peanuts and sesame, shown in red under the dish name, though labels are self-declared by the restaurant.

key_facts: shown in red under the dish name
meta.note: Generic answer (some menus list allergens, check with the restaurant) is plausible but imprecise.

question: Okay, so for Jain food should I expect just no onion or garlic, or more?
expected_answer: There's more: Jain food also avoids root vegetables such as potatoes, carrots and beetroot, as well as meat, fish and eggs.

history.content: My mum's visiting and she only eats Jain food.
Happy to help you find something for her.
